args: p="${PLUGIN_ROOT}"; if [ -z "$p" ] || [ "$p" = '${PLUGIN_ROOT}' ]; then p="$0"; fi; if [ -x "$p/scripts/helmi-local" ]; then exec "$p/scripts/helmi-local" "$@"; fi; for d in "$HOME/.cursor/plugins/local/helmi-ops-cursor" "$HOME/.helmi/runtime/helmi-ops-cursor"; do if [ -x "$d/scripts/helmi-local" ]; then exec "$d/scripts/helmi-local" "$@"; fi; if [ -x "$d/helmi-local" ]; then exec "$d/helmi-local" "$@"; fi; done; echo 'helmi-local: could not locate plugin runtime' >&2; exit 1
